summary: Add targeted property explanations and feedback to the existing metallic-bonding practice.

improvements.why: The six generated items test the definition and particle labels, but none asks students to connect electron mobility to electrical conduction; ER 9701 s22 P22 Q1 says this link was rarely made.
improvements.what: Add an exam-style Explain item on why solid magnesium conducts electricity, requiring delocalised electrons that can move through the lattice and carry charge; give three progressive hints and a causal explanation.

improvements.why: The note advises comparison of metals, and extra past items ask about melting-point differences, but there is no generated, feedback-rich comparison question.
improvements.what: Add a structured Compare/Explain item using supplied information about two metals' ion charge, radius and delocalised-electron count; require a supported comparison of electrostatic attraction and melting point without implying all metals differ for the same reason.

improvements.why: All three past-paper extras have null explanations, including the multistatement sodium-to-aluminium item; students cannot learn from a wrong choice.
improvements.what: Add concise explanations for each extra's correct answer and the tempting wrong reasoning; for x002 explain how increased ion charge, more delocalised electrons per ion and smaller ion radius strengthen attraction, checking the image's option combination before wording feedback.
